commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
90' Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.

90' What an opportunity! Rafa Mir (Elche) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
87' Ivan Martin (Girona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Miguel Sesma ignores the protests.
85' What was Juan Arango (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
83' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juan Arango (Girona) replacing Viktor Tsygankov.
82' The referee signals a substitution. John Donald (Elche) is brought on as a substitute for Marc Aguado.
78' Shots on target – 5:3.
76' Miguel Sesma has a clear sight and sees a foul from Victor Chust (Elche).
74' Alex Moreno (Girona) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
72' Here is a change. Alejandro Frances is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Rincon (Girona).
71' The game has come to an end for German Valera. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Adria Pedrosa (Elche).

71' Josan (Elche) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.

69' David Affengruber (Elche) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Rafa Mir. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
68' Thomas Lemar (Girona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
66' Substitution. Yaser Asprilla is replaced by Joel Roca (Girona).
66' Michel has decided to make a change. Thomas Lemar (Girona) replaces Vladyslav Vanat.
66' Axel Witsel will be replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
65' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) plays a through ball but overhits it.
61' Alejandro Frances (Girona) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Inaki Pena makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
59' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Hector Fort and he is replaced by Josan (Elche).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pedro Bigas departs the field of play to be replaced by Leo Petrot (Elche).
57' 3 - 0 Goal! Paulo Gazzaniga makes a huge mistake and Rafa Mir (Elche) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
56' A great solo run by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Inaki Pena.
55' Miguel Sesma blows his whistle as Rafa Mir (Elche) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
51' 2 - 0 Goal! Hector Fort shows great vision to find Rafa Mir (Elche) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
50' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
49' Ivan Martin (Girona) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
47' Aleix Febas (Elche) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Miguel Sesma no option but to blow his whistle.
46' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rodrigo Mendoza comes on the pitch for Grady Diangana (Elche).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
44' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
43' Aleix Febas (Elche) was too forceful with his tackle and Miguel Sesma interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
42' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
40' 1 - 0 Goal! Hector Fort plays a short, square pass into the path of German Valera (Elche), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
38' The ball is cleared after Alex Moreno (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.

36' That was close by Aleix Febas (Elche)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
36' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

34' Aleix Febas (Elche) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
33' Miguel Sesma blows for a foul after Yaser Asprilla (Girona) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
32' Grady Diangana (Elche) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
31' David Affengruber (Elche) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
27' Hector Fort (Elche) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 74:26.
23' Aleix Febas (Elche) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
20' Bryan Gil (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' German Valera (Elche) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Sesma blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Bryan Gil (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
16' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

16' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the top left corner is blocked by Inaki Pena, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
13' Alex Moreno (Girona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
12' Elche work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

11' A pass lands at the feet of Alvaro Nunez (Elche) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Elche.
9' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
8' Aleix Febas (Elche) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save to stop his effort.
6' Grady Diangana (Elche) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
4' Elche control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Hector Fort (Elche) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Elche will kick the game off.
Miguel Sesma was nominated as the referee for this game.
